{{Quote|This gangly creature is Jaxun. He's no Sith, but he's at least human.|Harkun insulting Jaxun in front of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]|audio=Harkun-GanglyCreatureJaxun-TOR.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Jaxun''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Jaxun was sent to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to learn the ways of the Sith. He stood with [[Argog]], [[Seferiss]], and [[Xivhkalrainik|Xalek]] where they would prepare themselves for their dangerous trials. He was introduced to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] by [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Harkun]], alongside other [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Acolytes]], but was favored by Harkun due to his [[Species/Legends|species]]. He died on his first trial, ultimately failing to become the apprentice of the future Dark Council member, Darth Nox.
